implementation: Queue submit/write captures active error scopes; captured states and per-submission leases survive guard pop. pop removes active scope then waits asynchronously for all captured work. Pending pop starts a completion worker, waker delivery and callback execution occur outside scope/backend locks

regressions: Later scope cannot capture an earlier submitted error
No-scope submission bypasses later scopes with no snapshot allocation
Cloned command parts retain pending scope until final lease drops
pop future returns Pending and wakes after completion
Real clear-buffer success and synthetic error completion are driven without caller polling
Reentrant waker polls Device without deadlock; newer scope stays clean

limits: Error completions are injected; no physical GPU fault/OOM claim
A pending scope pop starts a detached completion thread; pooling/resource limits and performance remain unqualified
The worker uses backend wait_idle; driver waits do not block the async caller but are not cancellable
Raw MetalDevice calls without logical sinks do not participate in scope capture
Native idle removal notifications and other backend runtime qualification remain open
